show: The Best of Coast to Coast AM
titel: The Secret War - Best of Coast to Coast AM - 9/4/26

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts; Ausschnitte dieser Sendung waren in zwei Messungen mit Stunden Abstand stumm - die Datei wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt

einzeiler: Alien abductions, shadow people and a spiritual war against dark forces.
kurzfassung: Heidi Hollis discusses her encounters with shadow people, hat man and extraterrestrial beings on Coast to Coast AM. She explains that malevolent entities and alien forces are connected to a dark, biblical threat. Furthermore, she emphasizes that spiritual faith and invoking the name of Jesus serve as protection against these encounters.
stichpunkte: Distinction between benevolent beings acting from the inside out and negative forces conquering the planet
Encounters with shadow people, hat man, and lake monsters linked to biblical darkness
Challenges faced within UFO groups regarding the true nature of abducting entities
The role of alien hybrids and how barriers can be created against them
Public backlash and denial from individuals defending negative alien entities
Using prayer and the explicit name of Jesus as a test and defense against dark beings

kapitel.titel: The Threat of the Hat Man and Spiritual Discernment

clips.text: The guest recounts being warned that lake monsters would appear more frequently because they originate from a dark source and represent biblical beasts.
The host asks for a definition, leading to the explanation that a hybrid is a half-human, half-alien entity frequently encountered during abductions.
An image posted online featuring negative alien entities alongside the red-skinned devil sparked heavy criticism from people defending those beings.
A haunting description of encountering a shadow entity with glowing red eyes that projected an overwhelming desire to kill.
Human intuition serves as a vital tool because reptilian beings walk among humanity, and uttering a specific religious name acts as a test against them.

beschreibung:
George Noory and author Heidi Hollis discuss her findings about a conflict between aliens and shadow people on Earth, how aliens have deceived humans to cover up their true intentions, and her encounter with a terrifyingly evil being known as the Hat Man.
